from fixtures import load_fixtures, ROWS
from tagged import labelled_goalss

VALUES = [v for _, v in ROWS]


def test_fewer_labels():
    pairs = labelled_goalss(list(load_fixtures()), ["a", "b"])
    assert pairs == [("a", VALUES[0]), ("b", VALUES[1])] + [("unlabelled", v) for v in VALUES[2:]]


def test_equal_lengths():
    data = list(load_fixtures())
    labels = ["l%d" % i for i in range(len(data))]
    assert labelled_goalss(data, labels) == list(zip(labels, VALUES))


def test_no_labels():
    assert labelled_goalss(list(load_fixtures()), []) == [("unlabelled", v) for v in VALUES]


def test_no_items():
    assert labelled_goalss([], []) == []
